identity.name: Pilatus PC-6 Turbo-Porter on Wipline 6100 amphibious floats
identity.engine: Pratt & Whitney Canada PT6A-27, 550 shp, Hartzell HC-B3TN-3D three-blade
notes: The H4 index (SB 149A, 1985): MTOW 2800 kg, extended composite wingtips (span 15.87 m, not 15.2 m), enlarged dorsal fin.
Rejected: FOCA TC F 90-05 (the Marabu, Baerfuss 1972) - not this aeroplane.
The floats: Wipaire Wipline 6100, AMPHIBIAN (the sheet and the photos: a nose wheel at each bow, dual mains aft of the step).
The airframe is the land PC-6/B2-H4 card (pc6_drafting_2026-11-11): the floats replace the main gear and the tail wheel; a ventral fin is added (the sheet).
